confirmed_note: Nine sessions passed four of five sole-occupant five-repeat pairings; the fifth missed at 2.038 and is retained. Eight passed four of four. Ten missed both of its pairings. Unchanged origin/main passed both of its eight-session pairings and missed all three of its nine-session ones, so nine is the rung the adapter change adds.

gate.name: 0.5x-speed floor
gate.rule: complete-task result_seconds p50 and p95 <= 2.0x, cold and warm
gate.serial_control: origin/main at one session, five fresh repetitions, run adjacently in the same exclusive four-core measurement group

isolation.enforced_by: cgroup v2 cpuset, 4 exclusive physical cores, 16 GiB, no swap
isolation.note: Every trial here ran after the measurement groups' occupancy guard was corrected. Readings taken before that fix shared CPUs with other work and are discarded, not published. Pairings that shared the host with a second pairing are retained but excluded from the pooled estimate and from the confirmation counts.

pooled.method: Every sole-occupant pairing's correct turns pooled, so one control draw does not decide a rung. The per-pairing verdicts remain the protocol; this is how they are read together.
